mediaWork.title: An Unreal Dream: The Michael Morton Story
mediaWork.publisherOrNetwork: Blue Bandana Productions, Glass House Productions, La Sonrisa Productions Inc. (A CNN Films documentary)
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: The wrongful conviction of Michael Morton for the 1986 murder of his wife, Christine, in Texas. Chronicles his nearly 25 years in prison and his eventual exoneration through DNA testing, highlighting severe prosecutorial misconduct.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: The story of Michael Morton, who was wrongfully convicted in 1987 for the murder of his wife and served 25 years in prison.

mediaItems.summaryNotes: Chronicles Michael Morton's wrongful conviction for the murder of his wife, his nearly 25 years in prison, and his eventual exoneration through DNA testing. The documentary highlights severe prosecutorial misconduct and the impact on Morton's relationship with his son.

featuredIndividuals.narrativeSummary: Wrongfully convicted of the murder of his wife, Christine Morton, in Williamson County, Texas. He served nearly 25 years in prison before being exonerated in 2011 through DNA testing. The case involved prosecutorial misconduct and flawed investigation.
